741380101.text: Hey! You're back. You missed out on something hilarious just now!

741380103.text: Just now, I brought the retrieved jellyfish and waited here for Mr. Augereau's inspection. But before he could show up, some of my buyers did.

741380104.text: They told me that ever since releasing the first several batches of jellyfish, they felt refreshed, and their business has been going super well. They thought it must have been a blessing from the heavens for doing a good deed! So they came back to buy more to release.

741380107.text: #Hmm... {NICKNAME} catches them, Mr. Kesean sells them, and buyers release them again... Hey! Is this your way of making money!?

741380108.text: What!? No! How could I!? I don't want any more trouble with the Gardes!

741380109.text: Ahem... I spent ages telling them that releasing these jellyfish does more harm than good, but they simply wouldn't listen!

741380110.text: They just believe that their luck was due to... what they consider to be a good deed.

741380111.text: They even believe that my bad luck was due to keeping the jellyfish in captivity. *sigh* Just what are they thinking...

741380112.text: Anyway, while we argued, Mr. Augereau arrived and immediately took them into custody.

741389901.text: We've already caught lots of jellyfish. Paimon wonders how the ecological recovery Kesean mentioned is going...

741389902.text: Let's go check on him! Hopefully he hasn't been taken away by the Gardes...
